text: **A.** Both responses find the same main bug, the off-by-one where `> this.limit` lets a sixth attempt through, and they order the issues sensibly. Both also run over the 200-word limit. A is closer to it, at roughly 210–230 words. B runs about 270 and adds a low-value "Minor" item about missing tests and key reset. B has slightly richer details, such as the IPv6 /64 prefix point and the `retryAfterSec` formula. A's items are still accurate and more concise, so it follows the length instruction better.
